notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
